history.content: Three customers churned this month — help me figure out why and what to do about it.

Rough month, sorry. Let's figure it out properly instead of guessing.

The fastest way in: for each of the three, do we know (1) when they last used the product before churning, (2) what they said at cancellation, and (3) how long they'd been customers? Those three answers usually separate "we dropped the ball" churn from "they were never the right fit" churn.

If you can paste in whatever notes or exit survey answers you have, I'll help you spot the pattern and draft a plan, win back outreach, fixes to the leak, whatever fits. What do the cancellations actually say?
